statement.en: With each claim in a context, what contexts show glues exactly where they agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere; Specker's boxes and the two-qubit Mermin–Peres square glue nowhere. Parts fail a whole by not giving it back or having none.
statement.zh: 每个主张都在某个语境之内时，诸语境所显示者恰在它们相交处一致时粘合，不依语境的主张的框架恰在处处粘合时合；Specker 的盒子与两量子比特的 Mermin–Peres 方阵在任何配置都不粘合。部分失去整体有两种方式：不给回整体，或没有整体。

laws.en: Claims are shown in contexts: which claims lie within each context, and what each context shows of each claim at each configuration. At a configuration what the contexts show glues where one context-free reading agrees with every context on every claim within it, and the contexts agree where every two contexts a claim lies within show it alike.
laws.zh: 主张在语境中显示：哪些主张在每个语境之内，每个语境在每个配置处显示每个主张的什么。在一个配置处，诸语境所显示者粘合，是指一个不依语境的读法与每个语境在其内的每个主张上一致；诸语境一致，是指同一主张所在的任意两个语境显示它相同。

laws.en: Where what the contexts show glues at a configuration, they agree there; where each claim lies within some context, they glue at a configuration exactly where they agree there.
laws.zh: 诸语境所显示者在某配置处粘合时，它们在那里一致；每个主张都在某个语境之内时，它们在某配置处粘合，恰当它们在那里一致。

laws.en: Read with its context, everything shown is a claim of a frame on any process, a context, a claim and a value, realized exactly where the claim lies within the context and the context shows that value. Where each claim lies within some context, some frame of context-free claims, a claim with a value, on a given process fits every context exactly where what the contexts show glues at every configuration.
laws.zh: 连同语境读，所显示的每一个都是任一过程上框架的主张（语境、主张与值），恰在该主张在该语境之内且该语境显示该值处实现。每个主张都在某个语境之内时，给定过程上有某个不依语境的主张（主张加值）的框架合于每个语境，恰当诸语境所显示者在每个配置都粘合。

laws.en: Where what each context can show depends only on the claims within it, no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities, and what every context shows at a configuration lies within its possibilities, what the contexts show at that configuration does not glue.
laws.zh: 凡每个语境能显示什么只取决于其内的主张、没有不依语境的读法落在每个语境的可能性之内、且每个语境在某配置处所显示者都在其可能性之内，诸语境在该配置处所显示者不粘合。

laws.en: Where what each context can show depends only on the claims within it, no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities, one configuration respects them, and each claim lies within some context, no frame of context-free claims on a given process fits what the contexts show, while the indexed frame does.
laws.zh: 凡每个语境能显示什么只取决于其内的主张、没有不依语境的读法落在每个语境的可能性之内、有一个配置尊重它们、每个主张都在某个语境之内，给定过程上没有不依语境的主张的框架合于诸语境所显示者，而以语境为索引的框架合。

laws.en: What a whole of possibilities allows within a context, the readings some possibility agrees with on the claims within it, depends only on those claims, and every possibility of the whole is a reading every context allows; the parts give the whole back where every reading every context allows is a possibility of the whole.
laws.zh: 一个可能性整体在一个语境中所允许者（某个可能性在其内主张上与之一致的读法）只取决于这些主张，整体的每个可能性都是每个语境都允许的读法；部分给回整体，是指每个语境都允许的每个读法都是整体的可能性。

laws.en: Where no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities and some context allows some reading, no whole of possibilities allows within each context exactly that context's possibilities; locality is not used.
laws.zh: 凡没有不依语境的读法落在每个语境的可能性之内、且某个语境允许某个读法，没有可能性整体在每个语境中恰好允许该语境的可能性；不用局部性。

laws.en: Specker's three boxes, any two opened together and exactly one of the two holding the gem: the openings' possibilities are local, no opening forces a box (each can show either way in every opening it lies in), and no placement fits every opening, no three two-valued boxes being pairwise different; a world showing the gem in each opening's first box respects them and does not glue, and they are the parts of no whole.
laws.zh: Specker 的三个盒子，任意两个一起打开，打开的两个中恰有一个有宝石：各次打开的可能性是局部的，没有打开强制任何盒子（每个盒子在它所在的每次打开中都可两样显示），没有宝石的放置合于每次打开（三个二值的盒子不能两两不同）；在每次打开的第一个盒子显示宝石的世界尊重它们而不粘合，它们不是任何整体的部分。

laws.en: The Mermin–Peres square, nine cells in three rows and three columns, each line a context holding its three cells, whose values must have even parity except in the third column, where it is odd: the lines' possibilities are local, no line forces a cell, no assignment of the nine values has every line's parity, and the possibilities are the parts of no whole.
laws.zh: Mermin–Peres 方阵：九格三行三列，每条线是持有其三格的语境，其值的奇偶须为偶，第三列为奇：各线的可能性是局部的，没有线强制任何格，没有九个值的赋值使每条线都有其奇偶，这些可能性不是任何整体的部分。

laws.en: Two-qubit observables realize the square as explicit integer 4×4 matrices: each squares to the identity, the three of each line commute pairwise, two sharing no line anticommute, and each line multiplies to −I in the third column and to I elsewhere.
laws.zh: 两量子比特的可观测量以明确的 4×4 整数矩阵实现方阵：每个平方为单位矩阵，每条线的三个两两对易，不共线的两个反对易，每条线的乘积在第三列为 −I，其余为 I。

laws.en: An integer vector shows a value at a cell where the cell's observable sends it to itself with that sign. Wherever a nonzero vector shows values at the three cells of a line, they have the line's parity, so what it shows jointly on a line is a possibility of the line; every possibility of a line is shown jointly by an explicit nonzero integer vector.
laws.zh: 一个整数向量在某格显示某值，是指该格的可观测量把它送到带该符号的自身。凡非零向量在一条线的三格显示值，这些值有该线的奇偶，所以它在一条线上共同显示者是该线的一个可能；一条线的每个可能都由一个明确的非零整数向量共同显示。

laws.en: No assignment of values to the nine cells of the square is shown jointly on every line, each line by some nonzero integer state vector.
laws.zh: 没有对方阵九格的赋值在每条线上被共同显示（每条线由某个非零整数态向量显示）。

laws.en: Along a run of any process, what the contexts show glues at a step exactly where the active claims of the world of readings at that step, each a context, a claim and a value, are read off one context-free assignment.
laws.zh: 沿任意过程的一次运行，诸语境所显示者在某步粘合，恰当该步读法世界中活跃的主张（各为语境、主张与值）都从一个不依语境的赋值读出。

laws.en: A contextual system of the square is quantum at a configuration where each line holds its three cells and what each line shows on them is shown jointly by a nonzero integer vector. Such a system does not glue there; along a run, the world of its readings is not context-free at a step where it is quantum; and no frame of context-free claims on any process fits it.
laws.zh: 方阵的一个语境系统在某配置处是量子的，是指每条线持有其三格，且每条线在其上所显示者由一个非零整数向量共同显示。这样的系统在那里不粘合；沿一次运行，在它是量子的步上，其读法世界不是不依语境的；任一过程上都没有不依语境的主张的框架合于它。

laws.en: A contextual system of the square, each line showing its own possibility, is quantum at every configuration; so along every run of every process its readings are fitted by no frame of context-free claims of that process and are context-free at no step.
laws.zh: 方阵的一个语境系统（每条线显示它自己的可能）在每个配置处都是量子的；所以沿每个过程的每次运行，其读法不被该过程任何不依语境的主张的框架所合，在任何步上都不是不依语境的。

hypotheses.en: No premise beyond the stated ones: gluing as agreement, and a frame of context-free claims fitting as gluing at every configuration, are two-way and need a context each claim lies within.
hypotheses.zh: 除所述之外不加前提：粘合即一致、不依语境的主张的框架合即处处粘合，两者都是双向的，要每个主张在一个语境之内。

hypotheses.en: Not gluing needs local possibilities, no context-free reading and one configuration respecting them, and the absence of a context-free frame needs also a context each claim lies within; having no whole needs some context to allow something, and does not use locality.
hypotheses.zh: 不粘合要可能性局部、没有不依语境的读法与一个尊重它们的配置，没有不依语境的框架另要每个主张在一个语境之内；没有整体要某个语境允许某物，不用局部性。

hypotheses.en: The quantum realization of the square uses real integer matrices and integer state vectors, values compared entry by entry.
hypotheses.zh: 方阵的量子实现用实的整数矩阵与整数态向量，值逐项比较。

does_not_show.en: Only possibilities are stated, not probabilities; no Bell-type inequality is stated.
does_not_show.zh: 只陈述可能性，不陈述概率；不陈述 Bell 型不等式。

does_not_show.en: General sheaf theory and the Abramsky–Brandenburger framework are not stated; only the gluing of values shown in context is.
does_not_show.zh: 一般的层论与 Abramsky–Brandenburger 框架没有陈述；只陈述语境中所显示之值的粘合。

does_not_show.en: No general parity obstruction is stated in these laws: the boxes and the square are each checked by evaluation.
does_not_show.zh: 这些规律不陈述奇偶障碍的一般定理：盒子与方阵各自由求值检查。

does_not_show.en: The quantum realization covers only this square; Hilbert space, measurement and Born weights are not stated.
does_not_show.zh: 量子实现只覆盖这个方阵；希尔伯特空间、测量与 Born 权重没有陈述。

does_not_show.en: That the parts give a whole back is stated for one type of values.
does_not_show.zh: 部分给回整体只对一个值的类型陈述。

detail.zh: Specker 的三个盒子与 Mermin–Peres 方阵：每个语境内一致，没有语境强制任何主张，没有不依语境的读法（Specker.noGlobal、Square.noGlobal）；量子比特实现方阵（Becoming.Quantum 的 no_context_free_values）。
detail.en: Specker's three boxes and the Mermin–Peres square: consistent within each context, no context forcing a claim, no context-free reading (Specker.noGlobal, Square.noGlobal); qubits realize the square (no_context_free_values of Becoming.Quantum).

next_delta.en: Probabilistic contextuality: weights on what each context shows, and when they come from one weighting of context-free readings.
next_delta.zh: 概率的语境性：每个语境所显示者上的权重，以及它们何时来自不依语境的读法上的同一权重。

correspondence.en: Following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026, answering his “wave/particle” (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-framing-and-pairs.md): the core's Frame reads claims as context-free by type; here that is named a commitment of the representation, with the condition under which it fits; what quantum measurements show is of the kind that does not glue (Kochen–Specker for two qubits, Mermin 1990, Peres 1990). The two ways parts fail a whole (not giving it back, as parity on Specker's pairs; having no whole) are the uniqueness and gluing conditions of a sheaf, for possibilities. AI readings: wave and particle are both projections onto context-free values; a value is what a context shows, a relation; the truth of Ren's speculation is relational. See §96 of the integration note.
correspondence.zh: 按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“push the frontier, as far as possible”，回答其“wave/particle”（sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-framing-and-pairs.md）：核心的 Frame 在类型上把主张读作不依语境，这里把它定为表示的承诺并给出它何时合的条件；量子测量所显示者属于不粘合的一类（两个量子比特上的 Kochen–Specker，Mermin 1990、Peres 1990）。部分失去整体的两种方式（不给回：如 Specker 诸对上的奇偶；没有整体）是可能性上层的唯一与粘合两个条件。AI 的读法：波与粒子都是向不依语境的值的投影；值是在语境中显示者，即关系；Ren 推测的“真”是关系的。见整合文档 §96。

detail.zh: 部分失去整体的另一种方式：奇偶是诸对不给回的整体，在同样的三对上。
detail.en: The other way parts fail a whole: parity is a whole its pairs do not give back, on the same three pairs.

detail.zh: 另一种投影的限制：从内部持有每个读法。
detail.en: Another limit of projection: holding every reading from within.

detail.zh: 语境中所显示者总是一个世界的关系项，不用粘合；World 的平衡是所立与交换两种变化读法的粘合。语境中的读法是一般情形。
detail.en: What contexts show is always the relata of one world, with no gluing; World's balance is the gluing of the standing's and the exchange's readings of change. The readings in context are the general case.

detail.zh: 回答其下一步“奇偶障碍的一般定理”：不依语境的读法恰在没有一组语境矛盾处粘合，矛盾时不依语境之赋值的混合平均至多满足 m 个语境中的 m − 1 个。
detail.en: Answers its next step “the general parity obstruction”: context-free readings glue exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts, and where one does a mixture of context-free assignments meets on average at most m − 1 of its m contexts.

history.en: 16 October 2026, P130 (every base read as a run): an application, not a new result. Becoming.ParityReadings states the square's quantum registrations on the world of readings along a run and on the frames of any process: a registration quantum at a configuration (Square.QuantumAt: each line registers its three cells, and what it shows on them is shown jointly by a nonzero state vector) does not glue (QuantumAt.not_glues), the world of readings is not context-free at that step (QuantumAt.not_freeAt), and no frame of context-free claims of any process fits it (QuantumAt.no_free_frame); quantum registrations exist at every configuration (Square.quantum, quantum_at), so along every run of every process the quantum readings are one world that no context-free description fits (Square.quantum_readings), proved through Square.no_context_free_values and Contextual.fitsFree_iff. 9 declarations added as a reference, bound to receipt 20261016T124157.989030Z; study section 165. Claim, limitations and status unchanged.
